File: README.md

Update the local setup steps in README.md to specify setting S3_ENDPOINT when using MinIO as an option, preventing uploads from hitting AWS by default.
args.title: Document S3_ENDPOINT for MinIO in local setup steps

args.body:
label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The local setup steps in README.md mention MinIO as an option but do not specify setting S3_ENDPOINT, causing uploads to hit AWS by default.
